success.description: The target is healed of 2 wounds, or of one critical wound severity 2 or less is converted into a normal wound.

boon.description: While this action is recharging, the target's Soak value is increased by 1.

bane.description: Lose 1 Cunning die from your dice budget.

sigmarsComet.description: One of the target's critical wounds (of any severity) is cured.

conservative.requirements: Engaged with target. Clear and present danger must threaten the target or the priest. This action gains {Df} if the target is a devout Sigmarite.
conservative.name: Sigmars Healing Hand

success.description: The target is healed of 3 wounds, or one critical wound of severity 3 or less is converted into a normal wound. While this action is recharging, the target’s Soak value is increased by 1.

sigmarsComet.description: Double the effect of any healing done by this blessing (twice wounds healed or critical wounds converted). Gottschalk loses 1 Cunning die from his dice budget.

reckless.requirements: Used by: Magnus Gottchalk. Engaged with target, currently in a combat scene. Special: This action gains {Df} if the target is a devout Sigmarite.
reckless.name: Sigmars Healing Hand
